articleTitle: Indoor scene recognition based on YOLOv8 improved loss function
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: With economic growth, indoor image’s application is being used more and more in the community. Because indoor scenes are too complex, and there are few technologies for indoor scene classification, a deep learning network framework YOLOv8-IIR was proposed, which is based on YOLOv8 and improved loss function for indoor scene classification. The original loss function was changed to Focal-EIoU in this article, so the geometric factor differences of the area where the rectangles intersect, their position and respective sizes in bounding box regression (BBR) were measured specifically from it, and the regression is observed in high quality anchor boxes, which is also maked from it. Furthermore, Ghost Convolution Deep and Cross Network(DCN) and Contextual Transformer (CoT) block were added on the basis of YOLOv8. Through the above improvement strategy, experiments were carried out on two data sets of home scene and office scene. Based on YOLOv8, the classification accuracy of YOLOv8_IIR has increased by 7.48%, so the accuracy of indoor scene recognition has been effectively improved.

articleTitle: Research on Used Car Valuation Model Based on SVM Fusion Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: As the global automobile trading market continues to expand, the valuation problem in used car trading becomes increasingly important. The current methods for evaluating used car prices involve complex steps and subjective evaluation results. The SVM-based used car valuation model addresses this issue by employing advanced methods, simplifying the steps, and reducing subjectivity. In this paper, we first utilize web crawler technology to collect and process data. We then analyze the correlation between data indicators. Next, we employ a support vector machine (SVM) for price prediction, utilizing feature engineering and principal component analysis for feature selection. We combine the selected feature indicators with greater information importance with the SVM model to enhance the prediction accuracy, thus optimizing the model’s effectiveness for used car price evaluation. To validate the success of our used car valuation approach, we use SPSS to analyze the correlation of data indicators. The experiment confirms that the SVM-based fusion learning used car valuation model exhibits high accuracy and serves as an important guide for the development of the used car market.

articleTitle: Time Improvement in the Production of Broiler Ovens for Grilled Chicken
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: According to the INEI in May 2023, the consumer price index in Metropolitan Lima increased by 2.67%, which increased the price of grilled chickens, with a demand of 150 million chickens per year, which requires more quality ovens to be manufactured in a short period of time. This work develops the improvement of production times in the production of ovens for grilled chicken. In order to improve production times, the direct observation method had to be used to find out the processes in the production stage and the time taken for each process, after which the possible causes that generate delays in the manufacturing stage were evaluated, detecting in the painting stage and a route diagram that was not productive, then it was evaluated by means of the analysis of DAP, DOP that allowed to examine the processes in detail and propose a new workflow with a curing lamp and a new route diagram, in addition to them improvements were considered in the production of oven to detect by sensors the state of the cooking of chickens and the option of cuts of chickens in 1/8, 1/4, ½, whole chicken and through simulation in FACTORY I / O was placed a robotic arm to add potatoes or salad. Finally, with proposal 2, production was increased by 100% and production times were reduced by 45.18% considering a yield of 80% in the drying stage by means of the curing lamp.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition Algorithm Based on ACNN-GRU
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: In the field of human activity recognition using wearable sensors, the accurate extraction of features from raw data and the development of an appropriate classification model are crucial for improving recognition accuracy. To respond to this and other challenges, we are put forward an ACNN-GRU deep learning model that amalgamate a convolutional neural network, a gated recursive unit, and an attention mechanism. The Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) virtually catch the spatial information in the sensor data, while the Gated Recursive Unit (GRU) models the temporal correspondence in the data sequence. By incorporating the attention mechanism, our model automatically learns and focuses on the salient features essential to activity recognition, resulting in more efficient extraction of fine-grained features from sensor data. Our method well identified six everyday activities: Walking, Standing, Sitting, Laying, Upstairs and Downstairs. Experimental results on the UCI open-source dataset demonstrate an impressive recognition rate of 97.65%, surpassing the performance of traditional classification models.

articleTitle: Optimal investment and retirement strategies for defined-contribution pension with jump diffusion risk process
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: An optimal investment strategy and optimal delay retirement time of defined-contribution pension which want to achieve the expected utility maximization problem of the terminal wealth were studied in this paper. Firstly, the stochastic differential equation with jump-diffusion is constructed where the terminal time is free, to describe the corresponding asset accumulation process under unknown retirement time. Then, a stochastic optimal control problem with jump-diffusion risk process is proposed, where the delay retirement time and the investment strategy are control parameter and control function, respectively. In order to obtain the optimal solutions of above optimization model with Cobb-Douglas utility function, the stochastic optimal control problem with free terminal time is transformed to that with determined terminal time by time-scaling transformation. After that, based on stochastic control theory, a Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation for stochastic optimal control problem with terminal time was derived. The optimal investment strategy is obtained by hypothesis method. Finally, sensitivity analysis and numerical simulation are performed.

articleTitle: Research and design of intelligent food delivery robot on campus under epidemic situation
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of campus food delivery under the epidemic situation, an intelligent food delivery robot with Raspberry PI (ROS system) and STM32F103VET6 as the control core be designed in this paper, which can achieve the goal of fully automatic food delivery in the dormitory. The Raspberry PI (ROS system) sends the food delivery command through WIFI, the system receives the command and responds, sends the speed command to the controller installed in the robot chassis and advances to the designated position according to the predetermined route, and sends the command to the system to prompt the students to take the food. The system mainly includes radar navigation, ultrasonic obstacle avoidance and voice prompt system and other modules to work together to complete automatic food delivery.

articleTitle: RANet: Lightweight Crop Disease Identification Model based on Reparameterization and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: A lightweight crop disease recognition model called RANet is proposed to address the issues of high parameter count, computational complexity, and poor real-time performance in using convolutional neural networks(CNNs) for crop leaf disease identification. Inspired by MobileNetV2, RANet introduces a reparameterizable basic module called RABlock. The structure of RABlock differs between training and inference, reducing model parameters and computational requirements while maintaining recognition accuracy and improving inference speed. Additionally, RANet incorporates the ECANet attention mechanism to enhance the model’s focus on disease regions, further improving recognition performance. On a custom-built leaf disease dataset, RANet achieves an identification accuracy of 97.98% with only 1.8MB of parameters and a computational complexity of 0.179G. The inference time for a single-leaf disease image is 2.5ms. RANet outperforms lightweight models like MobileNetV3, striking a balance between recognition accuracy and speed. These results provide valuable insights for deploying lightweight deep learning models on edge devices.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Evolution Architecture for Spacecraft Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of space missions and the growth on complexity of on-board software, improving the adaptive evolution ability of spacecraft control system becomes an important research issue. This paper focus on the adaptive evolution architecture of spacecraft software, which aims to solve the problems including software and hardware coupling, logic and information coupling, etc. And it introduces adaptive evolution layer to the architecture and enhances software flexibility through hierarchy and modularity. Besides, the dynamic parsing execution mechanism of evolution rule is proposed to provide the basic support for the dynamic adjustment through task scheduling, system parameters, and task logic. The architecture and mechanism have good application value for realizing adaptive evolution of spacecraft control system.

articleTitle: Self-tuning Path Planning Algorithm for Multiple AGVs via Time Window Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: The aim of this article is to propose a self-tuning path planning algorithm suitable for the cooperation task of multi-AGVs. The algorithm aims to address the conflict and deadlock problems that can occur when multiple AGVs collaborate in intelligent warehousing environments. Specifically, on the basis of baseline A* path planning algorithm, a self-tuning multi-AGVs path planning algorithm is proposed by adding the time window method. Detect conflicts by comparing the overlap between time windows, and then set virtual barriers at the conflict points to divert AGVs and ensure conflict-free path planning in a multiagent environment. Finally, the optimality of the proposed algorithm is proved by theoretical analysis and the improvement in overall task time efficiency is verified through numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Enterprise Service Quality Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: According to the characteristics of artificial intelligence industry and on the basis of understanding the meaning of service quality, this study constructs the service quality evaluation system of artificial intelligence enterprises through SERVQUAL and combined with the characteristics of artificial intelligence enterprises, so as to improve the service quality of artificial intelligence enterprises. 100 effective questionnaires containing the importance and satisfaction of 21 AI enterprise service quality influencing factors were designed and recovered, and the reliability, validity and IPA were tested. The analysis shows that through the above analysis, the secondary indicators located in the continuous maintenance area and key improvement area are divided into three aspects: hardware technology, user service and information security. The research results show that AI enterprises should set up products for different needs and formulate different marketing strategies according to the characteristics of users they serve. By formulating and implementing positive improvement strategies, artificial intelligence enterprises can achieve more effective and efficient performance.

articleTitle: An Efficient Computational Performance Analysis Method for CGRA-based Deep Learning Accelerator
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of deep learning technology and the Internet of Things (IoT), new applications are continuously emerging, such as image classification and object tracking, which require deployment on edge computing devices. These applications pose higher demands on computational complexity, latency sensitivity, and rapid iterative updates, while also challenging the energy efficiency and flexibility of edge computing devices. In previous research, we have observed that Coarse-Grained Reconfigurable Architecture (CGRA) maintains flexibility post-fabrication and achieves energy efficiency ratios close to ASICs, making it suitable for designing low-power, high-performance edge computing chips. As a result, research on CGRA-based deep learning accelerators has been steadily increasing. To rapidly assess the performance bottlenecks of CGRA in accelerating compute-intensive regions of deep learning applications and provide guidance for specific hardware designs before undertaking CGRA design, we propose a CGRA-based theoretical analysis method. This method enables quick evaluation of CGRA’s computational performance under deep learning workloads. Through experimentation, we have demonstrated that our theoretical analysis method is effective and can be used to guide CGRA-based accelerator designs.

articleTitle: Few-Shot Image Semantic Segmentation based on Contextual Information Encoding Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>In recent years, remarkable advancements have been achieved in the field of image semantic segmentation through the utilization of deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Nevertheless, the development of semantic segmentation is hindered by the requirement of a substantial amount of intensively labeled training samples in conventional deep learning networks. The objective of few-shot semantic segmentation is to accurately segment objects within a target class using a limited number of annotated images for learning. Currently, most methods in the few-shot segmentation field are highly sensitive to target categories, meaning that they have weak generalization ability and that segmentation results can vary greatly across different categories. Furthermore, a common drawback among many of these methods is the underutilization of the semantic information available in the support set, leading to suboptimal segmentation performance. To overcome these challenges, we introduce a novel strategy for encoding contextual information in our paper, specifically designed for few-shot image semantic segmentation. First, we propose a metric network to obtain prototype representations of feature classes from the supporting images. Furthermore, we introduce a novel Contextual Advanced Semantic Extraction (CASE) module to learn the trade-off between depth, width, and resolution. To mitigate the detrimental effects of foreground-background class imbalance, we also put forth a hybrid loss strategy as an additional contribution.

articleTitle: YOLOv5s detection method for road cracks based on residual and attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: Road surface diseases pose potential accident hazards to people’s safe travel. In response to the problems of missed detection, false detection, and low detection accuracy caused by blocked cracks in existing computer vision-based road crack detection methods, a Res2Net fusion attention mechanism detection method is proposed. Firstly, in the backbone network C3 Bottleneck, the ResNet module is optimized to a Res2Net residual network. By constructing hierarchical class residual connections within a residual block, more feature information is obtained while increasing the receptive field of the model; Secondly, the introduction of quality focal loss prediction classification scores and confidence scores of regression branches makes the localization of occluded targets more accurate; Finally, add an attention module to the detection head to improve detection accuracy. The experiment shows that the improved algorithm extracts more complete information. Compared with existing methods, the detection accuracy of this method has reached 62.5%, and the detection speed has reached 56 frames/s. It can quickly and effectively detect damaged road surfaces, reducing missed and false detections.

articleTitle: FasterV-RCNN: Efficient Point Cloud 3D Object Detection Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: Recent advances in 3D object detection rely heavily on the representation of 3D data. Several high-performance 3D detectors rely on a point-based structure as it preserves precise point positions. However, point-level features incur high computation overheads due to unordered storage. Conversely, the voxel-based structure is better suited for feature extraction but often results in slow inference times as the interaction between points and voxels can be time-consuming. In this work, we propose a new point cloud detection framework that dynamically and adaptively processes raw input point cloud data to achieve higher inference speeds. We conduct extensive experiments on the widely used KITTI dataset, and our results demonstrate that our proposed FasterV-RCNN method achieves higher detection accuracy compared to existing LiDAR-only methods while maintaining a real-time processing rate.

articleTitle: Multimodal Biometric Recognition Neural Networks with Branch Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: It is generally known that compared to unimodal systems, the multi-modal biometric systems can improve recognition accuracy by utilizing the complementary features of multiple biometric. Nevertheless, the modalities used may not always play equally important roles in multi-modal recognition. Especially, in practical application scenarios, it often occurs that some of the biometric samples are contaminated by noise and corruption. In this context, the multi-modal recognition systems should pay more attention to the high-quality modality than the ones with low-quality samples, so as to maintain high accuracy. In this paper, we proposes a multi-branch deep learning network for multi-modal recognition, each branch using one biometric sample as input. To highlight the more important biometric modalities, we propose to embed a branch attention module between branches before multi-modal feature fusion. The branch attention module includes fuse, select, and calibrate steps, which can dynamically calculate the weight of each branch based on its importance. The proposed multi-modal recognition model is tested on a chimeric bimodal dataset with the face and the ear modalities. Our proposed method still achieves 92.76% of rank-1 on the most contaminated dataset; the rest of the experimental results are shown in the Experiment and Performance Analysis section. Our experimental results clearly demonstrate that the proposed branch attention method can improve the multi-modal recognition performance.

articleTitle: Topology Control Algorithm for Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks Facing Data Theft Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: With the rapid development and increasing maturity of wireless sensor technology, a type of micro detection equipment that can work underwater has emerged, and this type of equipment has strong computing and communication capabilities, known as underwater sensor nodes. Numerous underwater sensor nodes collaborate to form an underwater sensor network through self-organization, which is mainly deployed in environments with water as the medium for monitoring, transmitting, and receiving messages. Different from traditional wireless sensor networks, underwater sensor networks are deployed in more special and complex environments. In order to improve the security of data transmission, this article proposes and verifies a topology control algorithm in underwater sensor networks aimed at reducing data theft rates, which makes node penetration follow a power-law distribution. By adjusting the node communication radius, the network achieves optimal performance. Finally, the performance of the algorithm was further verified through simulation experiments. The simulation results show that the network topology constructed by the proposed algorithm can maintain network connectivity and minimize the possibility of data being stolen by malicious nodes during transmission.

articleTitle: Chinese Continuous Speech Instruction Recognition Method Based on Improved Convolutional Neural Network in Noisy Background
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: The current structure of Chinese continuous speech instruction recognition in noisy background is generally set to one-way processing. Although it can achieve the recognition goal, the recognition efficiency is low and the error rate is increased. This paper proposes the design, verification and analysis of improved convolutional neural network (CNN) for Chinese continuous speech instruction recognition in noisy backgrounds. The recognition features of Chinese continuous voice commands are extracted by convolutional neural network. The convolutional neural network is improved by adding aggregation layer and improving convolutional layer, and the multi-level voice command recognition structure is set up. Based on this, establish an improved convolutional neural network Chinese continuous voice command recognition model, and use cross enhancement processing to set the recognition range and correct the output by cross-enhancement, achieve voice command recognition. The test results show that: according to the above measurement requirements, 5 Chinese continuous speech segments are selected as the main target objects and divided into 5 corresponding groups. The error rate of the final result is well controlled below 20% in the test stage, indicating that this command recognition method, with the help and support of improved convolutional neural network technology, can further improve the current recognition quality and efficiency.

articleTitle: The Application of EMD-ARIMA-LSTM Neural Network in Stocks
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: The Long short-term memory prediction model (LSTM) neural network model is widely used for time series prediction, with the advantage of being able to process some nonlinear long-term dependency data. However, there may be prediction lag and dependence on time series problems. However, traditional Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average model ( ARIMA ) have better processing performance for linear data and do not require a large amount of data for training. This article focuses on the issue of short-term stock prediction lag and excessive reliance on data. EMD-ARIMA-LSTM (Empirical Mode Decomposition Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average model Long Short Term Memory) based on attention mechanism is used to study and analyze the stock data of representative artificial intelligence enterprises in Tianjin. The research results indicate that the attention mechanism based EMD-ARIMA-LSTM improves the short-term prediction accuracy of stock prices by 1.7767% compared to traditional LSTM, which can provide reference and reference for relevant researchers.

articleTitle: MLEAT: An RL-based Approach for Vibration Damping System Control
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: Active vibration damping systems using PID controllers are widely applied in various industrial fields. The PID-controlled vibration damping systems can realize vibration damping depending on the appropriate PID parameters, which are not that easy to choose in practice. Therefore, adaptive tuning of PID controller parameters has been a focus of research in the industry. We propose a multi-level exploration adaptive tuning framework leveraging reinforcement learning algorithm, which enables adaptive tuning of PID parameters for vibration damping systems in response to vibration excitations, achieving the desired damping control effects. Without requiring prior knowledge, this algorithm ensures faster convergence and guarantees the stability of the damping system control. Experimental results in a simulated system demonstrate that our framework outperforms the baseline algorithm, achieving a performance improvement of 60% to 80% in the vibration damping system.

articleTitle: An Iterative Neighborhood Blending Method For Multimodal Product Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: Recently, the product matching and retrieval methods based on users’ real needs are becoming a hot spot in academic research, especially in the era of big data, more efficient and accurate matching methods become more necessary. Therefore, this paper aims to design an iterative neighborhood blending method for multimodal product retrieval, this method fuses image and text features of products that can efficiently retrieve items of interest to users from massive product data. First, the feature extraction model is trained by the classification head in the training stage. secondly, post-processing methods such as pooling, batch normalization and feature normalization method are designed to obtain feature vectors of different dimensions. Thirdly, product matching and retrieval are realized by an improved iterative neighborhood mixing method. Finally, experiments on the Shopee-Price dataset demonstrate that the iterative neighborhood blending algorithm brings significant improvements to the multimodal product retrieval task compared to the state-of-art.

articleTitle: Online-S2T: A Lightweight Distributed Online Reinforcement Learning Training Framework For Resource-Constrained Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: In deep reinforcement learning (DRL), it is generally resource-constrained devices that interact with real-time dynamic environments, and many DRL models are computationally complex, making online training challenging. Previous research has proposed policy distillation to compress the trained large models into small models thus satisfying the requirements of resource-constrained devices. However, this is usually offline and cannot be suitable for real-time dynamic environments. In this work, we propose an online student-teacher (online-S2T) distributed framework which can deploy multiple smaller student models to resource-constrained devices for online training. Specifically, we decouple the training and interaction of the teacher models and enable the student models to interact with the environment instead of the teacher models. Moreover, to reduce the communication overhead between multiple student models and the teacher model and speed up model convergence, we propose the key experience extraction algorithm. It obtains representative sets of experiences from numerous experience trajectories. The evaluation shows that our approach further accelerates model training and improves the performance of converged models by 25.12% on average, with the ability to deploy smaller models on resource-constrained devices for training.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Test and Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: The Unmanned Aerial Vehicle(UAV) equipment power led by the United States began to study the test and evaluation system and the construction of professional UAV test and evaluation conditions from the beginning of the 21st century, and formed a perfect standard system and test and evaluation system. China’s UAV technology and products have developed rapidly in recent years, but compared with Western military powers, China has started late in the construction of UAV test capabilities, and has not yet formed a systematic test and evaluation system. This paper starts from the analysis of the development status of UAV and UAV test and evaluation, combined with the actual situation of China, proposes the overall idea of UAV test and evaluation capacity construction, the main direction of UAV test and evaluation technology innovation, and the main content of UAV test and evaluation system construction, and strives to provide reference for China’s UAV test and evaluation capacity construction.

articleTitle: MFEFNet: Multi-scale Feature Extraction and Fusion Network for Semantic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: Achieving accurate semantic segmentation of complex scenes in remotely sensed images (RSIs) is of great significance for the interpretation of remote sensing big data. The inherent intra-class inconsistency and inter-class indistinguishability of RSIs make segmentation of different ground objects at various scales more challenging, while accurate mapping of edges for small-scale objects is also difficult. To address the above-mentioned problems, we propose a multi-scale feature extraction and fusion network, named MFEFNet, which uses adaptive spatial attention mechanism to capture spatial contextual information. The proposed network contains two modules, the single-level feature attention module (SFA-M) and multi-level feature fusion module (MFF-M). Specifically, SFA-M improves segmentation accuracy by obtaining multi-scale feature maps through the successive averaging pooling operation and adaptively aggregating multiscale information from coarse to fine, which can mine deeper spatial contextual information effectively. Besides, the MFF-M uses aligned convolution operations to make full use of the multi-level features, which have semantic gaps. The experiments and ablation studies have been conducted on the ISPRS Potsdam dataset. Quantitative analysis and visualizations show that MEF-Net can have good semantic segmentation performance. Numerically, compared to the mainstream model (SPANet,2022), MFEFNet (ResNet-50) improved by 1.68%, 0.9% and 2.02% in terms of mF1, OA and mIoU, respectively.

articleTitle: RAM-CG: Relation-aware Adaptive Model for Continual Graph Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: Neural networks excel at mining the static graph, but how to learn from streaming graphs without forgetting previous knowledge is an emerging challenge and well known as continual graph learning (CGL). Despite recent progress in this area, two significant challenges persist: 1) most of existing works only manipulate on the intermediate graph embedding and ignore intrinsic properties of graphs, which limits the learning method’s pertinence. 2) recent attempts obscure the transferable knowledge and lack explicit description for the transfer process. It is non-trivial to tell what and how the information is transferred across graphs. In this paper, we point out that latent relations behind graph edges, as an intrinsic graph property, can be attributed as an invariant factor for the evolving graph sequence and lead a possible knowledge transfer. Motivated by this, we design a relation-aware adaptive model, dubbed as RAM-CG, which consists of a relation analysis module to explore latent relations behind edges for message-passing and a task-awareness masking classifier to account for the shifting knowledge in the graph sequence. Extensive experiments show that RAM-CG provides significant 2.2%, 4.2% and 6.6% accuracy improvements over the state-of-the-art results on CitationNet, OGBN-arxiv and TWITCH dataset.

articleTitle: A Supervision Method for Online Violence Based on Blockchain and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: With the burgeoning development of the internet, online violence has metastasized into a formidable concern impeding cybersecurity and societal stability. This research proposes an innovative supervision methodology for online violence based on blockchain and deep learning technologies. The proposed technique harnesses the security, credibility, and traceability attributes of blockchain to ensure data integrity and authenticity alongside the efficiency, accuracy, and robustness of deep learning models for expedient text classification. Extensive experimentation on a 50,000-sample dataset validates that the introduced BCLD approach attains 0.95 accuracy and F1 score, outperforming baseline models by 4–5%. Additionally, balanced handling of positive and negative samples is demonstrated. The tamperproof nature of blockchain thwarts fraudulent data alteration. This pioneering methodology signifies a paradigm shift for constructing a wholesome online ecosystem.

articleTitle: Lightning short-impending prediction method based on SimVP spatio-temporal sequence prediction network
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: Lightning disaster is the most common one in nature, which has brought great impact on human activities. China has a large geographical span and complex climate conditions, and lightning weather is frequent and has a large range of influence. Timely and accurate lightning prediction can reduce casualties and property losses caused by disasters. Traditional lightning prediction methods include extrapolation and numerical models. Extrapolation methods calculate the movement trend of lightning through the past observation of lightning, and predict the future area of lightning by assuming that lightning movement parameters change regularly. Lightning prediction based on NWP mainly applies numerical prediction model to predict the future atmospheric elements, and judges the lightning area. Traditional lightning forecasting methods are difficult to capture the trend of lightning generation and development, and there are a lot of deviations in the forecast results. With the rise of deep learning, many works have applied it to lightning prediction tasks and achieved outstanding results. However, it is difficult to see innovation in lightning prediction tasks in recent years, and most works still use ancient deep learning models. This paper attempts to apply the advanced spatio-temporal sequence prediction model SimVP to the lightning prediction task, and studies what gain it can bring to the lightning prediction task. In order to adapt to the lightning prediction task, SimVP is simply modified in this paper to have the ability to predict future lightning occurrences based on historical radar and lightning data. Experimental evaluation is carried out on the real lightning data set of central Guangxi. The experimental results show that the performance of SimVP model is far superior to traditional prediction methods and other deep learning backbone networks, and the simple structure provides good scalability compared with the spatio-temporal sequence prediction model of the same period.

articleTitle: The Research of the Dashboard Display Status Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 Asia Conference on Advanced Robotics, Automation, and Control Engineering (ARACE)
abstract: The inspection of road-transport vehicles plays a crucial role in ensuring the safety and energy efficiency of vehicles entering the transportation market. It is an important aspect of enhancing the technical management of road-transport vehicles by transportation departments. The dashboard indicator lights serve as the main focus of the inspection, providing assurance that the vehicle’s active safety systems are functioning properly and serving as a key basis for determining the consistency of vehicle parameter configurations. However, manual detection and recognition of dashboard indicators in natural scenes can be labor-intensive and prone to false positives and false negatives due to the diverse distribution, varying scales, and complex backgrounds. This paper proposes improvements to the YOLOv5 framework to address the challenges encountered in dashboard detection, such as diverse distributions, variable scales, and complex backgrounds. The enhanced model incorporates an additional small-object detection layer on top of the three-scale detection, improving the detection performance for small objects at far distances. The FPN+PAN structure in the Neck network is replaced with the bidirectional feature pyramid network (BiFPN), which enhances information exchange between different network layers and enriches the feature information of small objects. Furthermore, the introduction of the coordinate attention mechanism (CA) before the detection layer increases the network’s resistance to interference, enhances the network’s focus on small objects, and improves object detection accuracy. Extensive experiments conducted on a custom data set demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves the expected levels of detection accuracy and speed. It effectively replaces manual detection methods and traditional detection algorithms, enabling efficient and precise identification of dashboard indicator lights at the moment of illumination. This research provides a reliable auxiliary tool for vehicle inspection work, contributing to the field of car dashboard display status detection.
